# @gears-frontx/framework

> Plugin-based application framework for FrontX SDK. Orchestrates SDK packages into cohesive applications with MFE (Microfrontend) support.

Part of the FrontX Framework Layer (L2) - depends on all SDK packages (@gears-frontx/state, @gears-frontx/mfes, @gears-frontx/api, @gears-frontx/i18n). Implements no layout business: the application owns its layout state and plugin. Type-system agnostic: depends only on the abstract `TypeSystemPlugin` contract; the application connects its own type system and owns its domain declarations and type IDs.

## Core API

- [createFrontX](https://frontx.dev/docs/framework/create): The one way to create an app (`.use(...).build()`); a runtime builds exactly one
- [presets](https://frontx.dev/docs/framework/presets): Pre-configured plugin arrays (full, minimal); `full()` adds auth only when `config.auth` is supplied and never contains the MFE host plugin (a host adds `microfrontends()` from `/mfe` itself) or a layout plugin (the application adds its own), `minimal()` is themes only

## Available Plugins

| Plugin | Provides |
|--------|----------|
| `themes()` | themeRegistry, changeTheme action |
| `microfrontends()` (`@gears-frontx/framework/mfe`) | mfeRegistry (MFE-enabled), MFE actions, selectors |
| `i18n()` | i18nRegistry, setLanguage action |
| `effects()` | Core effect coordination |
| `mock()` | mockSlice, toggleMockMode action |

## Quick Start

```typescript
// A runtime builds exactly one app: the two compositions below are
// alternatives, choose one per runtime.

// Alternative: compose plugins
import { createFrontX, effects, themes, i18n } from '@gears-frontx/framework';
import { microfrontends } from '@gears-frontx/framework/mfe';
const app = createFrontX()
  .use(effects())
  .use(themes())
  .use(microfrontends(config))
  .use(i18n())
  .build();

// Alternative: use the full preset, plus the MFE host plugin
import { createFrontX, presets } from '@gears-frontx/framework';
import { microfrontends } from '@gears-frontx/framework/mfe';
const app = createFrontX().useAll(presets.full()).use(microfrontends(config)).build();

// Access MFE-enabled registry
app.mfeRegistry.registerDomain(screenDomain, containerProvider);
await app.mfeRegistry.registerExtension(homeExtension);

// Access MFE actions
app.actions.loadExtension('home');
app.actions.mountExtension('home');
app.actions.unmountExtension('home');

// Access theme and i18n actions
app.actions.changeTheme({ themeId: 'dark' });
app.actions.setLanguage({ language: 'es' });
```

## MFE Plugin

The `microfrontends()` plugin, its actions, selectors and state types are on `@gears-frontx/framework/mfe` (they reach the MFE runtime). Its lifecycle actions take their action type IDs from the type system passed as `microfrontends({ typeSystem })`. The plugin provides:

### MFE Actions

```typescript
import {
  loadExtension,        // Load extension code
  mountExtension,       // Mount extension into domain
  unmountExtension,     // Unmount extension from domain
  registerExtension,    // Register extension dynamically
  unregisterExtension,  // Unregister extension
} from '@gears-frontx/framework/mfe';
```

### MFE Selectors

```typescript
import {
  selectExtensionState,       // Get extension state
  selectRegisteredExtensions, // Get all registered extensions
  selectExtensionError,       // Get extension error
} from '@gears-frontx/framework/mfe';
```

### Theme and Shared Properties

The plugin forwards the current theme's CSS variables to the registry (`registry.setTheme`). It publishes no shared property: the host publishes its own (for example theme and language) under its own type IDs with `registry.updateSharedProperty`.

### Domains and Action IDs

The framework declares no domain or type ID. Domain declarations and type IDs belong to the application's type system; lifecycle-action IDs are resolved through it (`registry.typeSystem.resolveMountExtActionId()`, …).

## Plugin Composition Pattern

```typescript
import { createFrontX } from '@gears-frontx/framework';
import { microfrontends } from '@gears-frontx/framework/mfe';

// MFE-enabled app; `typeSystem` is the host's TypeSystemPlugin implementation
const app = createFrontX()
  .use(microfrontends({ typeSystem })) // Provides mfeRegistry (MFE-enabled), MFE actions and domain management
  .build();

// Access MFE features
await app.mfeRegistry.registerExtension(extension);
app.actions.mountExtension(extensionId);
```

## MFE Types

```typescript
import type {
  Extension,              // Extension definition
  ExtensionDomain,        // Domain definition
  MfeHandler,             // Abstract handler for MFE lifecycle
  MfeBridgeFactory,       // Abstract factory for bridges
  ParentMfeBridge,        // Parent bridge interface
  ChildMfeBridge,         // Child bridge interface
  LifecycleStage,         // Lifecycle stage definition
  ActionsChain,           // Actions chain for lifecycle hooks
} from '@gears-frontx/framework/mfe';
```

## Concrete MFE Implementations

```typescript
import { MfeHandlerMF } from '@gears-frontx/framework/mfe';  // Module Federation handler
```
